headline: 2027 Wage Negotiations Kick Off at Conasami Amid Clash Over Elimination of MIR and Workers' Demand
summary: Labor, business and government delegations began deliberations on the 2027 salary resolution at Conasami. Labor pushed back against the proposed elimination of the MIR.
why: Conasami sets Mexico's minimum wage, which influences labor costs, inflation expectations and consumer spending. Its decisions affect employers across the economy.
original_headline: Arranca negociación salarial 2027 en Conasami con choque por eliminación del MIR y petición obrera
